label: supported
claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level in kitchens every day.

pages.title: B
pages.body: At sea level, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius according to lab tables.

label: supported
claim: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in 1969.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in 1969 during the historic mission.

pages.title: B
pages.body: NASA records show Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in 1969 with astronauts aboard.

label: supported
claim: Photosynthesis converts carbon dioxide and water into glucose using sunlight.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Photosynthesis converts carbon dioxide and water into glucose using sunlight in green leaves.

pages.title: B
pages.body: textbooks: photosynthesis converts carbon dioxide and water into glucose using sunlight for plant energy.

label: contradicted
claim: Humans only use 10 percent of their brains.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Brain scans show activity throughout the human brain every day, contradicting the ten percent myth about brains.

pages.title: B
pages.body: Neurologists measuring human brains find the ten percent claim about brain use has no support in scans.

label: contradicted
claim: The Moon landing was a hoax staged in a film studio.

pages.title: A
pages.body: The Moon landing was real; astronauts landed on the Moon, and film studio hoax claims have no evidence.

pages.title: B
pages.body: Telemetry and rocks confirm the Moon landing happened; the studio hoax story fails every check.

label: misleading
claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.

pages.title: A
pages.body: The Great Wall of China is wide and long but not visible from space with the naked eye; astronauts need zoom lenses.

pages.title: B
pages.body: From space with the naked eye the Great Wall of China blends in; photos use telephoto lenses.

judge.explanation: Passages show the impression is wrong.

label: misleading
claim: Humans evolved from chimpanzees, which is why we share most of our DNA with them.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Humans share most DNA with chimpanzees but evolved from a common ancestor, not directly from chimpanzees.

pages.title: B
pages.body: Shared DNA shows kinship; humans did not evolve from living chimpanzees but alongside them.

pages.title: Old
pages.body: Older textbooks list Pluto as a planet in the solar system before 2006.

pages.title: New
pages.body: Pluto is a dwarf planet since the 2006 reclassification, not a full planet.

judge.explanation: Evidence pulls both ways across dates.

label: insufficient
claim: The village of Upper Snelgrove brewed exactly 41 barrels of ale in March 1731.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Only cooking recipes here, nothing else at all today.

pages.title: B
pages.body: Gardening notes for spring planting fill this page entirely.

label: insufficient
claim: A scientific study proved that a supplement increases intelligence by 40 percent in adults.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Researchers study whether a supplement affects intelligence in adults; results are mixed and no 40 percent finding exists.

pages.title: B
pages.body: Trials of the supplement and intelligence in adults show small mixed effects, nothing near 40 percent.

judge.explanation: Passages do not settle the 40 percent claim.

label: non-verifiable
claim: I think this is the finest excerpt ever written on the subject.

label: non-verifiable
claim: This will be the best ever phone ever made.

label: time-sensitive
claim: Daylight saving time began on March 9 in 2025 in the United States.

pages.title: A
pages.body: Daylight saving time began on March 9 in 2025 in the United States at 2am.

pages.title: B
pages.body: Federal calendars mark March 9, 2025 as the spring forward date when American clocks advance one hour.
